# fileseekback

Moves a file pointer to the position that was marked by "filemarkptr" command.

```ttl
fileseekback <file handle>
```

## Remarks

Moves the file pointer for an opened file to the position marked by the "[filemarkptr](filemarkptr.md)" command.
The file is specified by &lt;file handle&gt;.

## Example

```ttl
fileseekback fhandle
```

See also the example of "[filestrseek2](filestrseek2.md)" command.
